title: Testing agent plumbing with TestModel and FunctionModel
description: test_agents.py replaces the language model with TestModel and a scripted FunctionModel so pytest can verify tool calls, validation retries, permissions, approval gates, and usage limits without Ollama.

steps.description: deps(tmp_path) pins today to 2026-10-07 and points notes_dir at a temporary folder. The first test uses TestModel to verify that days_until can be called with schema-generated arguments.

scripted(*turns) wraps a callback in FunctionModel to replay predetermined ToolCallPart responses. The next two tests verify that days_until uses the injected date and that an invalid date string produces a retry-prompt.
These two tests verify that saving a deadline for an unpermitted course ('HIST101') is refused without writing a file, and that a permitted course ('CS357') pauses with DeferredToolRequests.
The final test replays three tool calls under request_limit=2 and tool_calls_limit=2 to confirm that each limit raises UsageLimitExceeded.
